parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tickets (
    protocolo,
    cliente_id,
    titulo,
    descricao,
    prioridade
)
VALUES (
    'TK-' || extract(year from now()) || '-' ||
    lpad(nextval('tickets_protocolo_seq')::text, 6, '0'),
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4
)
RETURNING *;
select id from clientes where id = $1

parameters.query:
select
  t.*,
  coalesce(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'id', i.id,
        'tipo', i.tipo,
        'mensagem', i.mensagem,
        'criado_em', i.criado_em
      ) order by i.criado_em asc
    ) filter (where i.id is not null),
    '[]'
  ) as interacoes
from tickets t
left join interacoes i on i.ticket_id = t.id
where t.id = $1
group by t.id
